reviews.text: Always nice and do a good job on my dogs

They do a great job of trimming my dogs nails. I have a friend who brings their dog who hates getting his nails trimmed and they are even able to deal with him! He’s a little terror but they are very accommodating.
Been going to Johanna for so many years and she is so wonderful and caring specially to the seniors
Love it 🩷 great spot to take your dog …

This is truly the best grooming salon for our furry babies. They also offer mobile grooming, which is incredibly convenient. Johanna and her entire team are exceptional—they do a fantastic job and are very caring. My dog has knee issues, and Johanna took such great care with him during his bath and grooming. Their prices are fair and well worth it.
My babies always get extra care and attention from the staff. The staff is very friendly and kind with my babies and other pets. Very Recommended.
They cut Kitty my dog perfect
Thank you for welcoming my furry friends, they look lovely!!!
